body.x: Griffin Technology, co-developed and manufactured the Survivor + Catalyst Waterproof Case for iPhone 5.

The Survivor + Catalyst partnership unites Catalyst’s expertise in designing waterproof products with Griffin’s 20+ years of experience as one of the most established companies in the iOS accessory space, resulting in the best-in-class waterproof case.

“Griffin’s Survivor line has earned a reputation as the go-to brand in the protective case market,” said Mark Rowan, President of Griffin Technology. “Partnering with Catalyst to introduce the Survivor + Catalyst Waterproof Case further enhances our efforts to provide superior device protection, equipping users for anything life throws at them.”

“We’re thrilled to formally announce our partnership with Griffin and launch the Survivor + Catalyst Waterproof case at CES 2013,” said June Lai, CEO of Catalyst Lifestyle Ltd. “Catalyst has come a long way since the launch of the EscapeCapsule waterproof case on Kickstarter to a core group of design and tech enthusiasts who want to be able to go anywhere with their essential gear. As a young startup, our partnership with Griffin creates a stronger team with combined resources and expertise in the waterproof protective case market, and together we have designed, developed and manufactured one of the most technical waterproof products available today.”

Griffin’s original Survivor case is built to military standards and has become synonymous with extreme-duty protection for mobile devices, ready for everyday life and adventures. Since its introduction nearly two years ago Survivor has become Griffin’s best-selling protective case.
Adventurers can stay connected and capture special moments without hassle and be completely worry-free with Survivor + Catalyst Waterproof Case for iPhone 5, available late January 2013.
